subject: Ciências
description_pt: Testar e relatar transformações nos materiais do dia a dia quando expostos a diferentes condições (aquecimento, resfriamento, luz e umidade).

components.description_pt: Testar a transformação de materiais cotidianos quando expostos a condições como aquecimento, resfriamento, luz ou umidade
components.description_en: Test the transformation of everyday materials when exposed to conditions such as heating, cooling, light, or humidity
components.cc_component_description: Classify observed heating or cooling changes as reversible or irreversible based on evidence

components.description_pt: Identificar mudanças observáveis em uma substância causadas por aquecimento ou resfriamento

components.cc_component_description: Identify observable changes in a substance caused by heating or cooling

components.description_pt: Comparar o comportamento de diferentes materiais sob a mesma condição ambiental
components.description_en: Compare the behavior of different materials under the same environmental condition
components.cc_component_description: Compare properties of different materials to determine which best suits a specific function

components.description_pt: Relatar resultados de testes de transformação de materiais usando evidências observacionais
components.description_en: Report results of material transformation tests using observational evidence

cc_matches.description: Heating or cooling a substance may cause changes that can be observed. Sometimes these changes are reversible, and sometimes they are not.
Analyze data obtained from testing different materials to determine which materials have the properties that are best suited for an intended purpose.
